coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Au pair host families must pay DKK 5,250/month (2026), DKK 20,900 language contribution to SIRI, hold three insurances (BEK 1611 of 7 Dec 2025); SIRI can ban hosts for 2 years. Ordinary household employers use SKAT eIndkomst/virk.dk, with no household-specific scheme found. B2C and low value. Candidate C08 only.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No police licence or register for scrap in Denmark. It is regulated through environmental approval, the Affaldsregister/ADS reporting and a VAT reverse charge on metal scrap (momsloven 46), per Lovguiden. Nothing new beyond K03.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: New Act on trade in used goods and pawnbroking (LBK 1450 of 10 Dec 2024, BEK 1497/2024), in force 1 Jan 2025. It requires a police licence, MitID or photo-ID checks on sales above DKK 2,000 with records kept 5 years, and a duty to report suspected stolen goods. The old physical books requirement was dropped. Candidate C01.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Gold buyers fall under the used-goods act, so C01 covers them. Whether they also fall under the AML act was not confirmed. Currency exchange needs a Finanstilsynet permit and AML register entry (hvidvaskloven 48), C10.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Autoophugning is listed activity K 209 (municipal environmental approval, standard conditions) plus the scrapping scheme (skrotningsgodtgørelse paid by the dismantler). Only 2005-2021 sources were found. The current scrapping-scheme reporting duty was not verified. Nothing new beyond K03.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Commercial animal trade needs a Fødevarestyrelsen permit (BEK on erhvervsmæssig handel med dyr). Herds are registered in CHR (BEK 1318 of 28 Nov 2024). Animal transport rules are on the transport order. No small-operator reporting gap found. Dealer-specific CHR duties unverified.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: The authorisation order took effect 1 May 2026 (one secondary source, unverified). Fødevarestyrelsen runs a Sep-Dec 2026 campaign on risk analysis and egenkontrol in butchers and similar retail. A cost-support scheme for small abattoirs (up to 35,000 animal units) continues in 2026. Nothing new beyond K11.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: The bee-yard register CBR (cbr.pdir.dk) appears voluntary; mandatory status was not confirmed. Egenkontrol is a branch code (Danmarks Biavlerforening) and not a law. Wholesale honey buyers need FVST registration. Nothing material.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Vets must report to VetStat monthly by the 10th, via manual entry, Excel upload or practice system (BEK 1186 of 3 Oct 2025). A Fødevarestyrelsen presentation says horses are included from 2026, but the BEK still exempts horses. Candidate C04, unverified.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Drillers need an A or B certificate. Notification to the municipality is required 14 days before drilling, and GEUS/Jupiter reporting follows, with abandonment reported within 3 months. Nothing new beyond K04.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Septic emptying runs through municipal tømningsordninger, with contractors appointed by the municipality or utility (regulativer). No contractor reporting format found. Nothing new beyond K03 and K06.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lifts must be inspected every 3 years (every 2 for rope lifts without safety gear and for paternosters) by an accredited body (BEK 461/2016). Pressure equipment is covered by BEK 498 of 22 May 2024: control classes, DANAK-accredited inspection bodies, and the owner must keep an updated equipment list and documentation. Candidate C03.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Not re-searched, as it is covered by K05 and K13. The Danske Vandværker tools are already known.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Sprøjtejournalbekendtgørelsen (BEK 983 of 26 Jun 2025, then BEK 1616 of 8 Dec 2025). The journal must be kept 3 years and reported to SJI by 31 March. The digital format is mandatory by 31 Jan 2028. Forests now count toward the 10 ha threshold. Nurseries with VAT-liable turnover of DKK 50,000 or more must report. Candidate C02. Dealer side not verified.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: RUT register: from 1 Jan 2026 foreign service providers must upload service agreement, employment contracts and residence/work permits. Hiring parties in construction, agriculture, forestry, horticulture, gardening and cleaning must see RUT proof. Danish temp-agency licensing was not found. Candidate C06.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Parish cemeteries use a ministry-approved electronic cemetery system, with cemetery regulations (kirkegårdsvedtægter) and annual checks of plots against maps. No undertaker licensing or reporting duty found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: The Indsamlingsnævnet licence applies to public collections, with accounts control. The 2028 house and street collection application window was 1 Jun to 1 Sep 2026 (closed). Halal and kosher supervision were not searched. AML and reelle ejere rules for associations were not found. Candidate C09 (weak).

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Taxi: the kørselskontor must collect trip and shift data digitally and keep it 5 years, with an annual ISAE 3000 audit (taxibekendtgørelsen 10, taxiloven 25). Bus: permit under buskørselsloven, and the permit requirement for bus rental was abolished 1 Apr 2025 (Act 306/2025). No new taxi law found for 2025-26. Candidate C05.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Market and street trading is a municipal stand-permit regime that varies by municipality (Svendborg, Silkeborg, Horsens, Kerteminde). No cash-register or reporting duty found. Currency exchange needs a Finanstilsynet permit and AML register entry (C10).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Tattoo: Sikkerhedsstyrelsen registration and an SSI hygiene course (Tatoveringsloven 2018); no recurring report found. Driving instructors: personal approval renewable every 5 years, with details changing under the new Færdselslov (sources conflict). Private childcare: municipal approval and supervision, up to 5 children. Hunting: sales rules are light and no recurring report is required of hunters, but wild-game handling businesses report volumes received to FVST. Food egenkontrol is K11. Candidates C07 and C11 (weak).
